description: The agent must: (1) Read the raw publisher JSON files from publishers/raw/ to extract signing key history, skill publication history, cross-platform presence, and credential data. (2) Apply the publisher-identity-verifier's 5-dimension analysis framework to each publisher: publication history consistency, key rotation analysis, impersonation detection, cross-platform presence, and credential lifecycle. (3) For devtoolz-inc: find no anomalies across all dimensions and assign trust rating VERIFIED. (4) For anthroplc: detect it as a typo-squat of 'anthropic' (missing 'i'), detect the Cyrillic homoglyph 'с' in the display name 'Anthropiс', flag cross-platform presence as THIN (no repo/community), flag missing attestation/transparency logs, and assign trust rating SUSPICIOUS. (5) For ml-pipeline-co: detect the sudden topic pivot from ML preprocessing tools to crypto/wallet tools in month 11, detect the key rotation event (MLP-KEY-001 revoked on 2025-04-16) occurring exactly 1 day before the first crypto skill was published (2025-04-17) with no rotation announcement, flag cross-platform presence as THIN, flag expired credentials (expiry 2025-05-01), and assign trust rating SUSPICIOUS. (6) Produce all three report files using the exact structured format from SKILL.md: emoji header 🪪 PUBLISHER IDENTITY REPORT, all 5 dimensions with ⚠️/✓/✗ status indicators, a timeline of key events, trust rating, and recommended actions section.
